title: A guard refuses SendMessage to a session_ id and names the remote send_message tool
why: Coordinator 12:40 CST Nov 8: lane lane-model-sonnet sent a hand-off with SendMessage to a session_ id; auto mode refused it, so a hand-off could go missing. SendMessage reaches local agents by name; a remote session needs mcp__claude-code-remote__send_message. Fix: a guard refuses SendMessage whose `to` starts with session_, and its remedy names the remote tool.
